mapper.insert: insert into interview_questions (interview_id, user_id, question_no, question_content, difficulty, score, evaluation, answer_count, follow_up_count, status) values (#{interviewId}, #{userId}, #{questionNo}, #{questionContent}, #{difficulty}, #{score}, #{evaluation}, #{answerCount}, #{followUpCount}, #{status})
mapper.update: update interview_questions set evaluation = #{evaluation}, score = #{score}, updated_at = current_timestamp where id = #{id}
